# confkit — Complete Documentation for LLMs

This file contains the complete confkit documentation for language model indexing and reference.

## Project Overview

confkit is a production-ready typed configuration toolkit for Go. Version 0.5.0 is stable and production-tested.

### Philosophy

MINIMAL external dependencies. Use libraries only for essential tasks (YAML, TOML). Otherwise, pure Go stdlib. Keep core iron-solid. Configuration is the foundation—errors must be clear and safe.

### Status

- **v0.1–v0.5:** Complete and production-ready
- **v0.6+:** Planned (config composition, Prometheus metrics, advanced validation)

## Core API

### Load Functions

```go
// Variadic sources — shorthand for common case
func Load[T any](sources ...Source) (T, error)

// With fine-grained options (validators, middleware, interpolation)
func LoadWithOptions[T any](options ...Option) (T, error)

// File watching with listeners
func LoadWithWatcher[T any](filePath string, sources ...Source) (T, *ConfigWatcher, error)
```

### Error Handling

```go
// Format any error into human-readable string
// Safe to pass to log.Fatal without leaking secrets
func Explain(err error) string

// Type assertion for programmatic error inspection
type ErrorReport struct {
    Errors []FieldError
}

type FieldError struct {
    Path    string    // "Database.Password"
    Source  string    // "env", "yaml", "validation", "default"
    Kind    ErrorKind // "parse", "validation", "missing", "io"
    Rule    string    // "required", "min", "max", validation rule name
    Message string    // Clear error message
    Value   string    // Empty if Secret == true
    Secret  bool      // True if field marked secret:"true"
}
```

### Config Introspection

```go
// Scan struct and return field metadata
func ScanFields(v any) []FieldInfo

type FieldInfo struct {
    Name         string            // "Password"
    Path         string            // "Database.Password"
    Type         string            // "string", "int", etc.
    Tags         map[string]string // All struct tags
    IsSecret     bool              // From secret:"true"
    HasDefault   bool              // From default tag
    AncestorTags []map[string]string // Parent struct tags
}

// Dump config to JSON with secrets redacted
func DumpConfig(cfg any, fields []FieldInfo) ([]byte, error)
// Output: {"Password": "***REDACTED***", "Host": "localhost", ...}
```

## Struct Tags

### Configuration Tags

- `env:"VAR"` — Read from environment variable
- `flag:"name"` — Read from CLI flag (--name)
- `short:"x"` — Single-character flag (-x)

### Processing Tags

- `default:"value"` — Use if no source provides value
- `validate:"rules"` — Validation rules (required, min, max, oneof, custom)
- `secret:"true"` — Redact in errors, dumps, logs

### Documentation Tags

- `prefix:"PRE_"` — Prepend prefix to env/flag names in nested struct
- `help:"text"` — Description for schema and CLI help
- `hidden:"true"` — Exclude from CLI help output

## Validation Rules

### Built-in Rules

- `required` — Non-zero/non-empty value
- `min=N` — For int/float: value >= N. For string: length >= N
- `max=N` — For int/float: value <= N. For string: length <= N
- `oneof=a b c` — String must equal one of the space-separated options

### Custom Validators

Register per load-call, no global state:

```go
cfg, err := confkit.LoadWithOptions[Config](
    confkit.WithSource(confkit.FromEnv()),
    confkit.WithValidator("port-range", func(v reflect.Value) error {
        if v.Int() < 1024 || v.Int() > 49151 {
            return fmt.Errorf("must be registered port 1024–49151")
        }
        return nil
    }),
)
// Use in tag: validate:"port-range"
```

## Configuration Sources

### Built-in Sources

```go
confkit.FromYAML(path string) Source
confkit.FromJSON(path string) Source
confkit.FromTOML(path string) Source
confkit.FromEnv() Source                     // All os.Getenv()
confkit.FromFlags() Source                   // CLI flags
```

### Kubernetes Source

```go
// go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/k8s

k8s.FromKubernetesConfigMap(namespace, name string) Source
k8s.FromKubernetesConfigMapWithPath(namespace, name, mountPath string) Source
```

### Vault Source

```go
// go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/vault

vault.FromVault(addr string, auth VaultAuth, pathPrefix string) Source
vault.FromVaultWithKVVersion(addr string, auth VaultAuth, kvVersion int, pathPrefix string) Source

// Auth methods
vault.VaultTokenAuth(token string) VaultAuth
vault.VaultAppRoleAuth(roleID, secretID string) VaultAuth
vault.VaultKubernetesAuth(role, jwt string) VaultAuth
```

### Consul Source

```go
// go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/consul

consul.FromConsul(addr string) Source
consul.FromConsulWithToken(addr, token string) Source
consul.FromConsulWithOptions(addr, token, datacenter string) Source
```

### etcd Source

```go
// go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/etcd

etcd.FromEtcd(endpoints []string) Source
etcd.FromEtcdWithPrefix(endpoints []string, prefix string) Source
```

### AWS Sources

```go
// go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/aws

// SSM Parameter Store
aws.FromAWSSSMParameterStore(pathPrefix string) Source
aws.FromAWSSSMParameterStoreWithTTL(pathPrefix string, ttl time.Duration) Source
aws.FromAWSSSMParameterStoreMultiRegion(pathPrefix string, regions []string) Source

// Secrets Manager
aws.FromAWSSecretsManager(secretName string) Source
aws.FromAWSSecretsManagerWithRegion(secretName, region string) Source
aws.FromAWSSecretsManagerWithOptions(secretName, region string, ttl time.Duration) Source
aws.FromAWSSecretsManagerMultiRegion(secretName string, regions []string) Source
```

### Custom Source

Implement the Source interface:

```go
type Source interface {
    Name() string
    Lookup(field *FieldInfo) (any, bool, error)
    // Return ("", false, nil) if field not found
    // Return (value, true, nil) if found
    // Return ("", false, err) on error
}
```

## Supported Types

- **Primitives** — string, int, int8-64, uint, uint8-64, float32, float64, bool
- **Time** — time.Duration ("5s", "1m30s", "2h")
- **Collections** — []string, []int (comma-separated)
- **Nested Structs** — Unlimited nesting, prefixes concatenate

## Defaults

- Applied AFTER all sources loaded
- Only if no source provided a value
- Applied BEFORE validation
- Can use string interpolation: `default:"http://${HOST}:${PORT}"`

## Validation Behavior

1. Parse string values to types
2. Check validation rules
3. Apply defaults (only if field empty)
4. Resolve interpolations

If validation fails, defaults are NOT applied. Fail fast.

## String Interpolation

Use `${VAR}` to reference:
1. Other config fields (resolved first)
2. OS environment variables (fallback)

Example:

```go
type Config struct {
    Host    string `env:"HOST" default:"localhost"`
    Port    int    `env:"PORT" default:"8080"`
    BaseURL string `env:"BASE_URL" default:"http://${HOST}:${PORT}/api"`
}
// If no env vars: BaseURL → "http://localhost:8080/api"
```

## Secret Redaction

Mark sensitive fields:

```go
type Config struct {
    APIKey   string `env:"API_KEY" secret:"true"`
    Password string `env:"DB_PASSWORD" secret:"true"`
    LogLevel string `env:"LOG_LEVEL"`  // Not secret
}
```

Redaction happens automatically in:
- Error messages via `Explain(err)`
- Config dumps via `DumpConfig(cfg, fields)`
- Programmatic error inspection (Value field is empty)
- Help text and schemas (writeOnly: true)

## Hot Reload

```go
cfg, watcher, err := confkit.LoadWithWatcher[Config]("config.yaml",
    confkit.FromYAML("config.yaml"),
    confkit.FromEnv(),
)
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(confkit.Explain(err))
}

watcher.AddListener(func(oldCfg, newCfg any, err error) {
    if err != nil {
        log.Printf("Reload failed: %v", err)
        return
    }
    cfg = newCfg.(Config)
})

watcher.SetPollInterval(1 * time.Second)  // Check every second
watcher.Start()
defer watcher.Stop()
```

Polling uses mtime checks. All listeners called sequentially.

## Nested Structs & Prefixes

```go
type Config struct {
    App AppConfig

    DB DBConfig `prefix:"DB_"`

    Cache struct {
        Host string `env:"HOST"`
        TTL  int    `env:"TTL"`
    } `prefix:"CACHE_"`
}
```

Reads: `DB_HOST`, `DB_TTL`, `CACHE_HOST`, `CACHE_TTL` from environment.

Nesting is unlimited; prefixes concatenate.

## Schema Generation

```go
import "github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/schema"

// JSON Schema draft-07 compatible
s, _ := schema.GenerateSchema[Config]()
data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(s, "", "  ")

// Markdown reference table
md := schema.GenerateMarkdown[Config]()

// CLI --help output
help := schema.GenerateCLIHelp[Config]()
```

## Source Precedence

Sources are applied left to right; later sources override earlier ones **per field**.

```go
cfg, _ := confkit.Load[Config](
    confkit.FromYAML("defaults.yaml"),    // Lowest priority
    confkit.FromYAML("config.yaml"),      // Override defaults
    confkit.FromEnv(),                    // Override both
    confkit.FromFlags(),                  // Highest priority
)
```

For each field, the value from the rightmost source providing it is used.

Defaults are applied LAST—only if no source provided the field.

## Middleware

Modify values during loading:

```go
cfg, err := confkit.LoadWithOptions[Config](
    confkit.WithSource(confkit.FromEnv()),
    confkit.WithMiddleware(func(path string, value any) (any, error) {
        // Transform value before validation
        return value, nil
    }),
)
```

## Error Messages

When validation fails, Explain() produces:

```
Invalid configuration:

  Port
    error: must be between 1 and 65535, got 99999
    source: env (PORT)

  DatabaseURL
    error: field is required
    source: env (DATABASE_URL)
    value: <redacted>  ← Only if secret:"true"
```

Includes: field name, rule, actual value (redacted if secret), source.

## Real-World Examples

### YAML + Environment Overrides

```go
cfg, err := confkit.Load[Config](
    confkit.FromYAML("config.yaml"),
    confkit.FromEnv(),
)
```

### Environment Only (12-Factor App)

```go
cfg, err := confkit.Load[Config](
    confkit.FromEnv(),
)
```

### CLI Flags

```go
cfg, err := confkit.Load[Config](
    confkit.FromFlags(),
)
// Use: ./app --input file.txt --verbose -o output.json
```

### Kubernetes ConfigMap + Secret

```go
cfg, err := confkit.Load[Config](
    k8s.FromKubernetesConfigMap("default", "app-config"),
    confkit.FromEnv(),  // Override from env secrets
)
```

### Multi-Source with Vault

```go
auth := vault.VaultTokenAuth(os.Getenv("VAULT_TOKEN"))
cfg, err := confkit.Load[Config](
    confkit.FromYAML("config.yaml"),
    vault.FromVault("https://vault.example.com", auth, "/secret/myapp"),
    confkit.FromEnv(),
)
```

### AWS Secrets Manager

```go
cfg, err := confkit.Load[Config](
    confkit.FromYAML("defaults.yaml"),
    aws.FromAWSSecretsManager("prod/myapp"),
    confkit.FromEnv(),
)
```

## Comparison with Alternatives

### vs Viper

| Feature | confkit | Viper |
|---------|:-------:|:-----:|
| Typed Load[T] | ✅ | ❌ |
| Defaults via tags | ✅ | ⚠️ |
| Validation | ✅ | ❌ |
| Secret redaction | ✅ | ❌ |
| Cloud sources | optional | bundled |
| Runtime reloading | ✅ | ✅ |

Use confkit for: typed config, built-in validation, secret redaction.
Use Viper for: heavy runtime reloading, maximum flexibility.

### vs envconfig

| Feature | confkit | envconfig |
|---------|:-------:|:---------:|
| Typed | ✅ | ✅ |
| Multiple sources | ✅ | ❌ |
| Defaults | ✅ | ❌ |
| Validation | ✅ | ❌ |
| Secrets | ✅ | ❌ |

Use confkit for: comprehensive config management.
Use envconfig for: simple env-var-only loading.

### vs koanf

| Feature | confkit | koanf |
|---------|:-------:|:-----:|
| Typed Load[T] | ✅ | ❌ |
| Defaults | ✅ | ❌ |
| Validation | ✅ | ❌ |
| Many formats | ⚠️ | ✅ |
| Map-based | ❌ | ✅ |

Use confkit for: typed, validated config.
Use koanf for: dynamic configs, many formats.

## Installation

```bash
# Core (YAML, JSON, TOML, env, flags)
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit@v0.5.0

# Optional cloud modules (import only what you need)
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/k8s
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/vault
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/consul
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/etcd
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/aws
go get github.com/MimoJanra/confkit/schema
```

### Dependencies

**Core module:**
- gopkg.in/yaml.v3 — YAML parsing
- github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2 — TOML parsing
- Go 1.21+ (for generics)

**Cloud modules:** Only what you import.

## Design Principles

1. **Core is iron** — Load, defaults, validation, errors must be rock solid
2. **Not Viper** — Typed, explicit, validation-first. Not flexible-and-dynamic
3. **Struct-first** — Config as struct definitions. Everything flows from the struct
4. **Fail fast with help** — Validation eager, errors clear and actionable
5. **Minimal core, extensible edges** — 3-4 core files. Customization at the edges (v0.3+)
